_note: One small SVG per language, drawn rather than emoji: an emoji flag renders as two letters on Windows and as a different shape on every platform. Arabic has no flag of its own and ran on a neutral pan-Arab tricolour until Ramon picked the UAE on 12 Oct 2026: the Gulf is where the buyers are, and a reader there recognises their own flag faster than a tricolour that belongs to nobody. There is deliberately no flag for zh: Traditional Chinese is read in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau, and any flag put on it is a political claim rather than a language label. The menu renders the name alone, which the code already allows. Do not add one.
